title: Get Out

beat_descriptions.Opening Image: Andre (future Logan King) stalked and abducted from a suburban street at night.
beat_descriptions.Catalyst: Chris arrives at the Armitage estate — crosses into the strange world.
beat_descriptions.Break Into Two: Missy Armitage hypnotizes Chris — psychological manipulation begins.
beat_descriptions.Midpoint: Party scene. Logan King breaks character, screams at Chris. False victory collapses.
beat_descriptions.All Is Lost: Chris strapped to the basement chair, ready for the transfer. Fully helpless.
beat_descriptions.Break Into Three: Chris plugs ears with cotton stuffing, breaks Missy hold. Fights back.
beat_descriptions.Final Image: Chris and Rod drive away from the burning Armitage house.
